review_text: i can’t explain how much i love this cafe. i first visited it with a friend back in 2024 on a random friday, and somehow it still feels just as special. the taste hasn’t changed at all, and every drink is still served like its a piece of art im not even kidding. the first five photos were taken back in 2024, and the rest were from yesterday. this time i tried one of their refreshers, and it paired so well with the pasta. it took me a whole year to come back because we moved outside davao. but when i returned for college, this cafe was one of the first places that came to mind. thankfully i reserved a seat because it’s become so popular almost every table was already reserved by the time we arrived. they’ve added a few new touches to the interior, including these adorable hironos, but the whimsical feels that made me fall in love with this place is still there. it’s honestly the perfect cafe to catch up with friends and take cute photos❤️

This cafe truly impressed me. The food was delicious and the servings were generous, definitely worth every bite. Their drinks are to die for absolutely amazing and one of the highlights of the experience. Prices were very reasonable, especially considering the quality and portion sizes. The only downside is that the space is quite small, as it can only accommodate around 12 people. Because of this, reservations are highly recommended not just for seats, but also for the food since they sell out very quickly. Overall, it’s a great spot with excellent food and drinks, just make sure to plan ahead before visiting.

The Food was so creative and Good, they have unique choices of drinks. And the Place is quite small and they require reservations before you visit the cafe. And I would like to suggest to add some choices specially in their food but still their food is great. And I love how they decorated the place, it feels so homie and relaxing.

This is one of those very few places wherein the food prices are justifiable. FOOD - I have tried their pulled pork sandwich and pesto pasta a few times already and the flavors have been consistently good. The sandwich is not stacked and overwhelmed with multiple ingredients so you could really taste all that flavorful meat inside. You wouldn’t feel like their food is “tinipid” at all. As for the drinks, I mostly order their teas and I love how they have multiple options. Tea doesn’t feel like an afterthought for this place, though, of course, it isn’t like those East Asia and UK level dedication to tea serving. As for the other curated drinks, my friends loved the flavors. They truly know how to mix complementary ingredients. SERVICE - the staff are polite and know how to deal with customers. The orders are often served fast enough even when the space is full. PLACE - it truly represents its name: a secret garden. It’s filled with real plants and decorated with interesting art pieces. It is definitely a cozy place where you can relax with friends. The only downside is the size of the space since you only have a few inches of path in the middle to pass through once the place gets full. It can feel a bit cramped once this happens. You’re lucky if you get here at a not-so-busy time. I have (hehe) and it was such a relaxing, Ghibli-like experience. Another good thing is they have an online reservation system so you don’t have to worry if you’re gonna get seats or not. Just message their FB or IG page. I just hope they can open earlier so we could have brunch here. Their menu can pass off as brunch-worthy. Overall, this place lives up to the hype. The food is good. The service is good. And though the space is not as big as other cafés out there, I honestly wouldn’t want it any other way.

Had a nice experience at Secret Garden Cafe! It’s a small place but really cozy and homey. Loved their creamy carbonara and ube cake, both so good! Sadly, rice meals weren’t available that time. Music’s relaxing, and they accept both cash and QR payments. 💕

The Cafe offers a unique ambiance that combines a cozy atmosphere with a beautiful indoor garden setup. It has homey decor and a calm ambiance that makes visitors feel relaxed and at ease with picturesque indoor garden with plants and quirky trinkets, making every corner Instagram-worthy. I have not asked but I guess some of the merchandise here are a local art made by the owner or owner's personal selection. Also, due to limited seating, the cafe has an intimate setting, but reservations are recommended to secure a spot. The ambiance is complemented by their tasty food and drinks, including coffee, tea, sandwiches, pasta, and pastries. And as I see their menu, they really put efforts into carving their crafts. The drinks we ordered were well-made with a rich, full-bodied flavor, though for me and my friends, it was a bit too weak, so a stronger brew might suit better. Overall, The Secret Garden Cafe provides a charming and peaceful ambiance, perfect for those looking to unwind and enjoy good food and company.

I've been a customer since pre pandemic and it makes me happy that a lot of people now knows this cafe. They still serve delicious food and drinks. Kinda disappointed that they now have super slow internet. They used to have a fast one.

Definitely one of the best cafés I love going to 🤍 Must-try ang matcha and Alfredo pasta! It’s one of my go-to chill places. Sana lang ma-extend nila yung space since super small and walang parking—but overall, excellent talaga.

One of my personal fave cafes! Their menu has a great selection of drinks and meal, equally delicious and served in generous portions. Definitely worth price. However, their space is small and they don't take walk-ins so you need to book ahead if you want to visit. Also, there's no parking space outside so you might walk a little and burn some calories first. Still, the food and vibes make it all worth it. If you are looking for a cozy spot to indulge a good quality drink and food, this small cafe is a must!

By far one of the best cafe's I went to. Their food is really good. The place is really instaworthy but don't expect too much because their place is small. Really hoping they could expand their place but overall it was a 10/10! For those who want to go to this cafe, pls don't forget to book a reservation. Enjoy! <3

So much plants!! 😄 We were a bit surprised that they require a reservation, probably because the restaurant can only accomodate up to 16 people only. But their staff was amazing and accommodated us! They're very creative with their drinks and we personally like the one with the coconut milk. And we really enjoyed their Chicken Alfredo! It's not my choice of pasta but I really liked it. :) I'm not sure though if the space can be improved. It's really a tiny cafe and on a full house, it's not recommended for those who are claustrophobic. It doesn't help also that some seats are literally beside the restroom, customers may lose their appetite. Overall it was a good place with good food. We would prefer to go this cafe when there's only a few people. We hope they can expand their garden so even when the house is full, we can (and the plants) can still breathe. 😅

Soo it's been a while, Transferred to Davao so I'll be doing more reviews here. First review, Secret Garden. Literally a Secret address. It's a place without parking so be prepared to have be look for your own. The food is great. The portion is a bit on the smaller side and the drinks are okay. Let's talk food because they got the taste right. This is my first visit so I got only 2 dishes and two drinks. They got the soup right but it's on the sweeter side. Beef stroganoff tasted like beef stroganoff. The meat portion was smaller. But for its price of 180. Pretty good. Drinks. Got the Thai coffee milk tea(?) But had too much ice in it. The taste was a little bit watered-down. Might have been a problem with their consistency, so I might be going back just for this. We'll see. Let's talk place. Quite small. Could cater to about 15 people. Tight space for 15. Soo do go here on rush hours. Or weekends. So yeah I'll be trying this place again. For now 3/5 overall

I’ve been wanting to try here for so long. Honestly, it didnt disappoint! Just the interior of the place already gives homey vibes, what more the comfort of their grilled cheese x tomato soup. I also ordered their earl grey matcha latte, didnt expect how big the serving is!

It's such a tiny yet well-decorated space and for sure plant lovers are gonna fall in love w the place. The food is great, too! I recommend trying out the grilled cheese and their pasta, too, as it is what they're known for. Perfect hangout space for people who loves good food!

It is a small place. However, their SERVICE IS SUPERB. Right when we got in, we were surprised with free ice cream. Wow. The first time I saw this kind of service in the phillipines period. I think it is a family owned business. you order from the counter, then you will be served. Parking is a slight challenge. However, it is worth it, no wonder that Filipinos gave this place a high praise. I must say their service and food are way above excellence. This is a must visit place indeed. I highly recommend patronizing it, please. Businesses like this are worth having around.

This is one of the most beautiful cafes I've visited in Davao. The place is small but it is really well decorated with lots of potted aerial plants. Its highly recommended that you contact their FB pages and get a reservation. We've tried their classic pulled pork sandwich and chorizo bacon pesto pasta and they are scrumptious. Their drink menu is really wide and with pictures so you can select a drink based on how they look. The matcha cheesecake and pistachio rose cream were really attractive that we just had to order and they did not dissapoint. We will visit again next time and try their coffee drinks.
Visited 15/9 around 4pm. The lady who’s on shift on that day was amazing. Her service was excellent! The sandwich and the drinks were great. We will surely comeback soon. 🥰
Everything has been so consistently good! Love their Grilled Cheese Sandwiches (Bacon and Maple & Classic) and Garlic Chicken Alfredo. Their House Iced Tea is refreshing and delicious.

Snug and small location, good for small groups of 2-3 people. Clean venue and facilities. Food are good for snacks and light meals, pricing is moderate (P150 average). Carbonara and fries are savory. House blend is made with real tea. Limited parking.

The Secret Garden Cafe lives up to its name. It's a hidden gem in a residential subdivision that offers some lovely coffee, pasta, and one of the best grilled cheese sandwiches I've had so far. The place is quaint and has a few seating but it's not crowded. The ambience is very nice, green and cozy. They have a lot of well curated pieces that make the Cafe both look like a garden and an artist's haven. Prices are also reasonable for the good quality of food and drinks they offer. My only issue would be the parking. If you don't mind walking, you can drop your car by savemore but I wouldn't recommend it in the evening as the street can be quite dim. Overall, I'm impressed and will definitely come back more often.

If you’re planning to go here, make sure to make a reservation on their fb page as the place is quite cramped, and it’ll be difficult for you to find a seat if you just walk in. Once you get inside, you’re greeted with a unique ambience as the place is decorated in plants, and a collection of stuff that makes the interior eclectic. In terms of the drinks, I love the fact that they do not serve your regular coffeeshop drink! They offer a wide selection of drinks to choose from that makes you wanna go back and try more of their menu. At the same time, I really loved their sandwiches! They probably have the best sandwiches I’ve tasted here in any coffeeshop in Davao. Btw, they also serve you soft serve ice cream which adds a very nice touch to their hospitality. It makes you, the customer feel welcomed and valued. My only gripe with the place aside from the fact that you’ll need a reservation, is that it’s quite far from the city proper, and parking is a bit difficult, but overall would highly recommend!
Such a cozy space! I just love the atmosphere here! Would love to go here again.

The place is nice, you'll love it if you like small spaces and plants. I would prefer it to be a bit bigger though, witb tables where you can face other people straight. Staff are very nice. Only tried one of their drinks and I think it was good, although I was looking for a more flavorful taste since I felt like all I could taste was the creaminess. Would still recommend though and will update this review once I taste more of their menu.

Worth the drive! Did not expect the food and drinks to taste as good as they looked but we were all very satisfied. The ambiance was calm and mellow. Serving time takes a chunk of their 2-hour time limit but we didn’t mind.
Nice and small coffee shop. Make a reservation first, but expect it to be a crowdy place still. But food and place is soo cute so it's worth it 😝🤭

A cafe surrounded by plants. 🌿🌱 Been eyeing to come here since 2017 & finally got the chance to pass by this coffee nook in Bangkal. Though I was only able to stay for a short time but it was worth the trip. 😅 + make sure to plan ahead as they prefer to make a reservation due to limited seats available.

I sure hope this cafe doesn’t stay a secret. The place itself has a really cozy atmosphere - filled with antiques and plants. We tried their espresso, Tustado Coco and Beef Stroganoff - all tasted great. They also had accomodating staff who were kind enough to give out free ice cream and butter cookies.

This place does not miss. The drinks were fantastic (I had the?blue lavender?) and it was smooth with just the right amount of sweetness. My friends who got the food here were also so impressed. There's gorgeous art for sale and the atmosphere is a 10/10

Certainly ❤️I had an amazing dining experience. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting even the space is limited but it's enough, the service was impeccable, and the food was absolutely delicious. From the appetizers to the desserts, each dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor. The staff were attentive and knowledgeable, making excellent recommendations. Overall, it was a memorable evening, and I can't wait to dine there again! Thank you for the free ice cream ❤️

It's tiny, but its really cozy. They recommend you to get a reservation and I understand why. Seats can get full quick. Food serving was very, very generous. Food is good naman pero we found ourselves taking a few bites because it can be very overwhelming on its own. Mauumay ka. 😔 pero ewan ko rin ah, we didn't get the first choices we wanted kasi unavailable eh. I think kaya pa naman bigyan ng chance 🤗 Drinks on the otherhand - really really good! One thing lang when it rains, tumutulo. So maybe that's something they should look into since its already rainy season. 🤙
I lovee the foods here I suggest: -Beef stroganoff -beef and mushroom sandwich -tropical fruit drink
Atmosphere is good, Cheese sandwich is awesome !! S'mores is very tasty , fries were nice , great place to spend some quality time, make sure to reserve before you go

Finding a good quality sandwich shop in Davao that offers a wide range without sacrificing flavour is rare. As a visitor, I get the hype I hear from my sisters, particularly with how herby the sandwich was! Alam mong di ka nila tinitipid!!!
Ideal for solo or for a small group of 2 to 3. Good food. So many options for their handcrafted signature drinks. Prompt service.
A very beautiful, tiny but still a spacious cafe...good food and good surrounding ! The sandwich here was really really good ! Cheesy, tasty and crisp ! Lovely ! ❤️

Secret na medj inde charrr but I like the placeee~ My go to cafe if I'm near bangkal but sadlyy I'm wayy too far 🥺 additionally they got free ube ice creammm Had their Carbonara and Strawb Latte (I think) and my friend got the Apple Refresher and Beef Stroganoff whichh costs around 800+ pesos

Best grilled cheese sandwiches in the city! 😋😋😋 We love all of their sandwiches - beef & mushroom, pork sandwich, bacon, etc. Yummy drinks also! We love their creamcheese bongblanc, matcha espresso fusion, tiramisu, etc place is filled with beautiful plants. Feels very homey. Staff is nice and attentive. Quality of food is consistent. This place is a must-try!
If you considering, Coffee shop hopping! This is a good reco to visit - Place is awesome and so as the Staff :)
We had fun but it was limited to two hours only so kinda bummer but everything still looks and tastes great so 👍
10/10 food though a bit small the area is best to reserve a table a head to time
While service and food were all superb, the space was small and feels congested. Also, they have no parking space.

Too cramp, so when the place is full, the noise level is elevated. The width for walking to and from the seat and the order counter is less than a meter when the seats are taken. Not an ideal place for meet up.

I love the place, good food, good coffee and drinks the menu is very creative and the place is very nice. So much plants in the cafe you wanna geek and nerd out about it. It's like a hidden forest cafe in the middle of the city. Also the owner have lovely digital artworks and the service is very good! One of my fave cafes in town and its very underrated with its rustic and authentic vibe

I visited this cute cafe a few times when a friend suggested it to me. I had to park there before they even opened or ordered in advance for pick up. Really tiny and not suggested for groups bigger than three people and with vehicles. The CLASSIC really is a favorite as well as the Asian and Aglio e olio pasta. The tomato basil soup is really something too….The variety of beverages they have also are all really interesting to try. Ambience is cozy. Accommodating staff too. It’s worth going back there from time to time….
Go-to café, the matcha cheesecake drink and the s'more one is our fave ❤️Much better to reach out to their Facebook page first before going there to reserve your spot.

Place is very instagrammable! IG Pepz will definitely love this place. Just an honest opinion, I tried their Caramel Macchiato which by the way my favorite, less coffee and more milk which I think has a low quality, sa bisaya pa lasaw ang gatas. Would I go back? I'm a bit skeptical kay first impression lasts na sa akoa, but if naay chance why not? Pero gidayo pa naku ang cafe coz of TikTok hype and I was a bit disappointed pero let's give another chance and maybe try a different one. Oh by the way, the brownie was too sugary. Next time I'll go for pasta nalang 😃

I recommend the Classic Sandwich paired with their good tasting Coffee latte. But if you are not into coffee that much then the House Blend Ice tea would just hit the spot. You can also try their Carbonara pasta, one of the best Carbonara in town if you ask me. The place is also equally great, serene little cafe vibe! Overall great experience 5 out of 5!

We reserved the place for 7 people a day before, and still, when we went there, we were not even given proper seats. Moreover, if you don't want people to reserve, why bother giving an option. We were looking forward to dining in there. Very upset about this.
I love the coffee and ambience here. Felt like home. Tiny2 place. Maybe can seat 7-8 people at a time but the coffee and food is really good.

Must-try ang cookies and brownies! Definitely one of THE best I have tasted. Affordable and masarap naman ang food especially the grilled sandwiches. Great place if you want a cafe that's not too crowded or not known to many. Cozy and full of art ang interior. Ganda!
Food and coffee is really great and would give a 9/10. Service is 10/10. I recommend their waffles 100%. Wish they would open earlier especially on the weekends.
It's a lovely place . I was left mesmerized. The food is too good . A bit pricey but worth it .
Indeed a secret place for a very delicious food that havent been known by many...🤗 soooo inlove with their foood❗️ sooo recommendable …
Pretty drinks & tasted great too!
Burnt Umber is surprisingly good 😊. I highly recommend Hot Caffe latte, the coffee beans used for there coffee is heaven.
Aesthetiiic plus affordable and worth the price 💓🥳
good food but limited parking space. i hope they can provide more parking areas. if you come here do not bring your suv.
Plants and art! Lovely place!
Everything was perfect, the place was good and the foods were great. This will be my new fav. spot in bangkal. Will definitely recommend this place to my friends!!!
Very small, we reserved and went but they didn't save a spot.
Small place but cozy. Staff is very polite and nice. Great place for coffee and tambay ✨
So good and homy, though not spacious but very nice and sandwiches are yummy.
great food and coffee. if only they opened early this would be perfect
The coffee was bad. Almost no taste at all. Place is a bit cramped.
Nice place. Somewhat small but good food and feel
Google asked me to rate this place and I did not even know I was there. So, five stars for a very appropriate name.
Serves delicious food. Small but cozy.
would love to romanticize my study sesh here 🍃🌱
Great food, good prices, lovely ambiance and service! ❤💕 …
Grilled sandwich and pasta is LOOOOVEEEE 😭😭❤️❤️❤️🫰
Not for coffee enthusiast, food is decent though
Good food. Loved the tiramisu latte
Delicious food, friendly staff, nice ambiance
The food and the place was great!
A secret place good for a cup of coffee.
Chill place.

The drink I ordered was vanilla einspanner, I really love it, and it's very greeny, and very nature giving, I love everything, I saw a video on TikTok and finally went there and yeah, I expect what I expected, definitely recommend to visit.

We decided to try The Secret Garden Cafe and we didn't expect some of the food to be so delicious. Aside from the taste, the presentation of some drinks is also very nice. You can see that they don't skimp — it's right for the price you pay. The place itself is cozy and relaxing, perfect for chill hangouts or catching up with friends. The only downside is that they open late (around 2:30 PM) and close early (around 8:30 PM), so the time is a bit limited if you want to visit. Overall, it's worth visiting if you like a quiet cafe with good food and drinks. A place you'll likely discover through word of mouth.
